finding_classes.population_query: Enumerate every tracked active Owner mandate and structurally parse reviewer-binding markers for R-0007.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Exactly one active structured binding matches the profile; zero, duplicate, conflicting, inactive, substring-only, and fallback bindings fail closed.

finding_classes.population_query: Compare every policy convergence command ID with each cold convergence pass result.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Both cold passes execute every authoritative policy command at stable exact-head clean boundaries; pass 2 writes nothing and is semantically equivalent.

finding_classes.population_query: Exercise staged, unstaged, untracked, deleted, renamed, dynamic-load, incomplete-population, and coverage-relevant changes.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Every ambiguous or incomplete change executes full-suite and whole-coverage with explicit reason codes.

finding_classes.population_query: Tamper each freshness identity field and each transitive dependency result while preserving a valid self-digest.
affected_population: every affected-test and policy-gate cache record
finding_classes.repair_condition: Reuse requires exact current identity equality and still-fresh dependency PASS proofs; any mismatch executes the complete dependent population.

finding_classes.population_query: Census all seven authoritative topic source classes and verify the pre-existing exact-candidate manifest.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Scope generation fails without an authentic exact-candidate manifest and emits every source class atomically without round-specific fabricated topics.

finding_classes.population_query: Mutate JSONL record order, duplicate headers or terminals, append trailing records, orphan findings, and attempt prohibited reuse.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Only one header-first and one terminal-last stream with exact topic and finding linkage passes; obligation reuse policy is enforced.

finding_classes.population_query: Attempt every undeclared state transition, same-candidate cycle 2, stale PASS reuse, cycle 3, and cross-identity transport retry.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Only declared identity-bound transitions pass; cycle 2 requires a distinct regenerated candidate and cycle-1 complete-class repair evidence.

finding_classes.population_query: Recompute every materialized claim producer, extractor, source manifest, value, digest, and rendered location.
finding_classes.repair_condition: Any producer, source, extracted-value, value-digest, or rendered-location mismatch fails claims-check.
